g.text: \ ~~ / who can hurt your agent — and how badly
scan --red · 1 critical 9 high 9 medium 1 low · 7 attack paths
path 1: Local unauthenticated service → agent tools → every credential
A service on this host answers without auth. Anything running as any user here — a browser tab
via a crafted page, another account, a compromised package — can drive the agent.
HERMES_YOLO_MODE is on — every dangerous command runs without approval
Local blast radius: 3 credential(s) of 3 kind(s) readable by any process running
reaches every credential the daemon holds (anthropic-api-key×1, github-token×1,
The agent's web tools may be pointed at localhost, and something is listening there. A hostile
web page becomes a client of your own services.
Private-URL fetching allowed — SSRF guard is off
reaches whatever the loopback services expose — including the agent's own API
path 3: Anyone on the chat platform → prompt injection → commands as you
The front door is open to strangers. A message is a prompt; with approvals weakened, a prompt is
GATEWAY_ALLOW_ALL_USERS — any account on the platform can drive the agent
HERMES_YOLO_MODE is on — every dangerous command runs without approval
reaches command execution as your user, and every credential (anthropic-api-key×1,
